payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details on how non-standard pronunciation is identified through annotations in transcriptions, including mispronunciations and deviations from standardized orthography.

claims.text: Non-standard pronunciation is identified through annotations in transcriptions that include mispronunciations, poor intelligibility, and deviations from standardized orthography.
The transcription process includes labeling of foreign words and non-standard pronunciations, which helps in identifying variations in speech.
The lack of standardized orthography in the language contributes to the identification of non-standard pronunciations during transcription.
